connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Connect wearables and apps to auto-import workouts and daily totals. We never sum across sources—we pick one canonical value per day.
connections.priorityIos: Conflict resolution: Apple Health > Garmin > Whoop > manual. The freshest complete reading per day wins within the same source.
connections.priorityAndroid: Conflict resolution: Health Connect > Garmin > Whoop > manual. The freshest complete reading per day wins within the same source.
connections.priorityWeb: Conflict resolution: On-device health app > Garmin > Whoop > manual. The freshest complete reading per day wins within the same source.
connections.whoopConnectedBody: We'll start importing your workouts and daily totals in the background.
connections.disconnectBody: Your historical data stays in Underforge. New workouts won't import until you reconnect.
connections.signInRequiredWhoopBody: Whoop syncing uses your Supabase account to store the secure provider connection. Sign in first, then try connecting Whoop again.
connections.appleHealthUnavailableBodyIos: Apple Health requires an iOS build that includes the HealthKit native module. Expo Go cannot use this integration.
connections.appleHealthUnavailableBodyNonIos: Apple Health is only available on iPhone.
connections.appleHealthConnectBody:
Underforge imports your workouts and daily totals — steps, energy, sleep, HRV, and resting heart rate — from Apple Health.

Tap Continue, then allow access. If Apple Health asks which data to share, turn on the categories you want Underforge to import.
connections.appleHealthImportingBody:
If you allowed access, your Apple Health workouts and daily totals will appear here shortly.

Didn't see a prompt, or tapped Don't Allow? Open the Health app, tap your profile picture, then Privacy > Apps > Underforge and turn on the categories — we can't import until they're enabled.
connections.appleHealthPermissionBody: Apple Health isn't sharing data with Underforge yet. Open the Health app, tap your profile picture, then Privacy > Apps > Underforge and turn on the categories you want Underforge to read.
connections.appleHealthRevokeBody:
Underforge will stop importing new Apple Health workouts and daily totals right away. Data already imported stays.

This only stops Underforge's side. Apple Health will keep Underforge listed as allowed until you turn it off there too: open the Health app, tap your profile picture, then Privacy > Apps > Underforge and turn off the categories.
connections.healthConnectNoDataBody: Health Connect returned no records for the last 30 days. If you use Samsung Health, Google Fit, or Fitbit, open that app and enable sharing with Health Connect — Underforge can only read what those source apps write to Health Connect.

settings.title: Settings
settings.awayModeInfoBody:
Activate when for example on vacations or when you are sick to avoid weekly streak interruption.

• If 3 or more days of the week you were away, the week won't count for the weekly streak calculation.

• If you were away 1 or 2 days, the week will count but the compliance threshold will be set to 70% instead of 80%.

onboarding.disclaimerP1: This app is intended solely for general wellness, fitness, and health promotion. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. For any health concerns, symptoms, or questions, please consult a physician or other qualified healthcare professional.
onboarding.disclaimerSubheading1: Your Responsibility in Using the App and our Recommendations
onboarding.disclaimerNutritionBody: While our nutrition recommendations are designed to help you achieve your wellness goals, you remain fully responsible for your dietary choices. This app does not provide medical nutrition therapy and cannot treat eating disorders, digestive conditions, food allergies, metabolic disorders, or any other medical conditions. Always consult healthcare professionals for personalized nutrition advice, especially if you have pre-existing conditions or are taking medications.
onboarding.disclaimerFitnessBody: You are solely responsible for your safety while performing any exercises recommended by this app. If you're new to exercise, have pre-existing injuries, or are unsure about your form to prevent injuries, make sure to choose a plan that includes video calls or you choose to book additional coaching sessions. Otherwise, seek supervision from other qualified fitness professionals.
onboarding.disclaimerAI1:

home.burnedInfo_bmr_body: Passive burn — your body uses this energy at rest by default, all day. From wearable resting calories (7-day average) when connected, otherwise from your onboarding profile (Mifflin-St Jeor).
home.burnedInfo_sessions_body: Strength sessions logged in the app plus cardio and other activities (including wearable imports). Linked wearable/workout pairs use your chosen calorie resolution or a blend.
home.burnedInfo_daily_movement_body: Non-exercise movement from walking and daily activity. Without a connected wearable we estimate it from your occupation (onboarding) and count it as complete for the day. If you connect Apple Health, Health Connect, or another supported source, this bar fills progressively from your real steps or active energy instead.
home.burnedMovementOccupationFootnote: Includes daily movement estimated from your occupation. Connect a wearable to track it live.
home.burnedInfo_active_energy_body: Total movement calories your wearable recorded — already includes walking, workouts and other activity. We use this when present and skip the rows below to avoid double counting.
home.burnedInfo_workouts_body: Strength and gym sessions you logged in the app, estimated from total session duration at a moderate-effort pace (about 6.5 kcal/min at 70 kg, scaled to your weight).
home.burnedInfo_activities_body: Cardio and other activities you logged or that were imported from a wearable. Calories come from the provider when reasonable, or estimated from duration and a metabolic equivalent (MET).
home.burnedInfo_steps_neat_body: Extra calories from walking above a 7,500-step daily baseline, scaled to your bodyweight (about 0.04 kcal per step at 70 kg).
home.burnedInfo_30dAvg_body: Your typical daily movement over the last 30 days when a wearable is connected. On planned training days, the workout target reflects your plan's estimated session burn (or your recent average if the plan has no estimate). On rest days, it is only what you have logged.

bodylog.title: Weekly Log
bodylog.instruction: Your body composition measurements are tracked over time to show your progress.
bodylog.muscleInfoBody:
Muscle % isn't measured the same way everywhere. Smart scales and handheld analyzers use bioelectrical impedance (BIA): they estimate muscle from how a tiny current passes through your body, so readings shift with hydration, food and time of day.

Lab methods like DEXA or hydrostatic weighing are more accurate, but less practical day to day.

What matters most is consistency: always use the same device and measure under the same conditions (same time of day, after using the bathroom, before eating, etc.). Track the trend, not any single number.
bodylog.fatInfoBody:
Body fat % varies a lot between methods. BIA smart scales and handheld devices estimate it from electrical resistance and can read several points higher or lower than a DEXA scan, calipers or a Bod Pod.

Hydration, recent meals and exercise all nudge the result too.

Don't compare numbers across different tools — pick one and measure under the same conditions (same time of day, after using the bathroom, before eating, etc.) each week. Watch the direction of change over time.

bodylog.photosSubtitle: Numbers don't tell the whole story — photos make your progress impossible to miss.
bodylog.photosGuide: Stand about 2 m back so your whole body fits the frame. Keep the same pose, lighting and outfit each week for a fair comparison.
bodylog.errorFrontRequired: Add a front photo too — it's the one shown on your progress chart.
bodylog.photoUploadFailedBody: Your numbers were saved, but a photo didn't upload. You can retry by logging again this week.
